title: Minipurge:Yellow
description: Add-on to Minipurge. Keeps players coming back to mid to collect loot that generates there.
body:
# 🟡 Minipurge: Yellow | Mid-Loot & Ambush Add-on

**Control the center, control the game!** Minipurge: Yellow is an official add-on for the [Minipurge](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minipurge) event framework that adds high-stakes objectives to the middle of your arena. 

If players tend to camp on the edges of the border and avoid fights, this add-on changes the meta entirely. By periodically dropping valuable loot at the center of the map, it forces players out of hiding and creates a natural hotspot for intense PvP engagements. 

---

## ✨ High-Stakes Features

* **🎁 Center Loot Drops:** High-tier loot will occasionally generate at "mid" (the starting structure). It keeps players coming back, but beware—someone might be waiting in the shadows!
* **⛏️ The Netherite Rush:** Exactly four pieces of Netherite generate at the starting structure right as the game begins. Will you risk rushing a diamond pickaxe to claim it early, or will you let someone else mine it and sabotage them for the ultimate steal? 

![Loot generating near mid.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9988daa804954393f084db09611784ee5d304c09_0.webp)

---

## ⚙️ How to Install
1. Make sure you have the core **[Minipurge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/minipurge)** data pack installed in your world.
2. Drop the `Minipurge:Yellow` `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder alongside it.
3. Start your event normally! Minipurge will automatically handle the structure and loot generation.

---

## 🛠️ Create Your Own Add-ons!
Minipurge is built to be a modular framework. Want to make your own custom events, loot tables, or structures?
